title: Recording: Long Haired Lady by Paul and Linda McCartney; Little Lamb Dragonfly by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil Ramone, Dixon Van Winkle

Paul and Linda McCartney worked on the songs ‘Long Haired Lady’ and ‘Little Lamb Dragonfly’ on 3 February 1971.

This was the third and final orchestral session for the Ram album. George Martin’s score for ‘Long Haired Lady’ featured trumpet, horn, trombone, piccolo, clarinet, and bass clarinet. As before, Paul conducted the session musicians.

Following a break for lunch, they were joined by string players. Violin, viola, cello, and bass was added to ‘Little Lamb Dragonfly’. The session ran over time, and studio owner Phil Ramone persuaded all but one of the players to remain behind.

‘Little Lamb Dragonfly’ had been earmarked for McCartney’s Rupert the Bear animated film, but was eventually released on Wings’ second album Red Rose Speedway.
